title: Grand Theft Auto 2/Controls
text:
These are the default controls.

Game

thumb|Control tab of GTA2 Manager (Windows)
While the game is paused, the following are displayed consecutively:

 Target Score
 Jobs Passed for each gang
 Total Jobs Passed
 ../Kill Frenzies/ Passed
 ../Tokens/ Collected

Other Windows controls can be changed by opening , selecting the Control tab then the Default Keyboard, 'Classic' Keyboard or Controller button from Default Controls on the right, to set Current Controls on the left to be used the next time the game is opened. Current Controls can be individually changed by selecting a control button, then pressing the key you want to use for it.

PlayStation and Sega Dreamcast controls can be changed using the Controls option on the title screen or main menu.

Special makes a pedestrian burp or fart, and a vehicle sound its horn or toggle any siren.
